compound.label: Plus-que-parfait
compound.why: had already happened before something else

links: Futur and Conditionnel share the stem filtrer-. Learn one and you have both.
The Imparfait stem filtr- is the nous form of the Présent (filtrons) with -ons removed.
The Subjonctif stem filtr- is the ils form of the Présent (filtrent) with -ent removed.
The Impératif is the Présent with the pronoun dropped.
